sentences.text: Lauren Zoe `` Laurie '' Hernandez -LRB- born June 9 , 2000 -RRB- is an American artistic gymnast .	artistic gymnast	artistic gymnast
She competed as a member of the U.S. women 's gymnastics team at the 2016 Summer Olympics , winning gold in the team event and silver on the balance beam .	2016 Summer Olympics	2016 Summer Olympics
